script_text: Taurus, this week the cosmos is rewriting your love story and your bank balance simultaneously. As Venus, your ruling planet, sextiles Jupiter in your 2nd House early week, unexpected money flows in between Monday and Wednesday — a bonus, a refund, or a lucrative offer lands directly in your lap. But watch Tuesday when Mercury squares your natal Sun, creating tension in conversations — don't sign anything binding. The turning point arrives Thursday when the Sun trines Pluto in your 10th House, igniting a powerful career breakthrough that shifts your entire trajectory. By Friday and through the weekend, Venus drifts into your 5th House of romance, Taurus, and suddenly someone from your past resurfaces with genuine intentions. Saturday evening is electric for love. Your best day is Thursday because the Sun-Pluto trine in your 10th House opens a door that stays open. Your worst day is Tuesday due to that Mercury square clouding your judgment. This week, Taurus, ground yourself in your earth element and trust what your body tells you before your mind catches up. Follow for daily updates.
